text:
Maya Chen: Kickoff for ZenWave onboarding — quick sync. High-level goal: get ZenWave using Redwood hosted API for initial pilot, then evaluate Dedicated. Target: prod pilot by 2024-05-24. Can we confirm owners for infra, enablement, and success criteria?

onboard-bot: New onboarding thread created for ZenWave by Maya Chen — checklist prepopulated. Link: https://app.redwood.ai/onboards/zenwave

Samir Patel: I can own infra integration (API keys, VPC egress, allowlist). Will spin up a test harness and basic perf smoke tests. ETA: initial harness by Tue next week.

Priya Rao: I'll be primary CSM/ops for customer comms and scheduling. Need a 60min enablement + admin walkthrough for their infra team.

Elliot James: AE note — ZenWave requires SSO (SAML) + EU data residency. We flagged renewal risk if residency isn't clearly addressed in the pilot.

Maya Chen: Noted. Preliminary success criteria proposal: 1) ingestion pipeline completed end-to-end, 2) gen call p95 < 400ms in pilot region, 3) <2% errors on production-like traffic, 4) first 10k tokens/day within cost projection. Thoughts?

Samir Patel: Those look reasonable. EU region baseline: we can provision hosted in eu-west in ~1 week for testing; Dedicated capacity provisioning is ~2 weeks. If they need guaranteed residency, Dedicated is the route.

Priya Rao: Can the infra team provide a short pre-recorded admin walkthrough (5–10min) we can send to the customer's ops team by Friday? That helps accelerate signoffs.

Elliot James: I'll assemble an initial eval prompt set + 2 regression tests to validate quality. Will drop them here later today.

Maya Chen: Action owners: Samir = infra & region provisioning, Priya = customer comms + enablement scheduling, Elliot = evals/prompts. I'll schedule a standing Wed 10am PT sync starting next week.

Samir Patel: One blocker: I need their network contacts and IP ranges for allowlisting. @Priya can you capture and share? Also need confirmation if they accept hosted fallback or require Dedicated from day 1.

Priya Rao: On it — I'll collect firewall contacts, SAML attribute mapping, and their legal note on residency. Putting details into the ZenWave intake sheet and will share link.

onboard-bot: Task created: 'ZenWave - enablement session' assigned to Priya Rao, due 2024-05-03.

Maya Chen: Perfect. I'll upload the success criteria doc + tentative timeline to the intake sheet and tag everyone. If no other blockers, I'll send the calendar invite for Wed 10am PT. :thumbsup:
